killedBy: the legal document disclosures names each toggle by its document alone, with the state word out of the name
why: Renames every disclosure from "Privacy" to "Privacy Show", and makes a screen reader announce the collapsed/expanded state twice -- once from the name, once from `aria-expanded`. The same two-announcements-of-one-fact collision issue #629 called out between the achievement rows' visible marker and their `ui-sr-only` span, arrived at from the other direction. Nothing else can see it: hud.a11y.test.ts's sweep asks whether a control has a NON-EMPTY name and whether that name is a bare digit, and "Privacy Show" passes both.
